articles.author: Saami abbas Khan
articles.description:
Recently, I was scrolling through Instagram and came across this amazing habit-tracking template on Notion. But when I tried to download it… surprise, it was paid. Ah, the pain. 😅
Instead of endlessly searching for free alternatives or settling for something that didn’t quite click, I did the non-obvious thing: I made my own.
Enter Focus & Grow – a minimalistic, distraction-free monthly habit tracker that I vibe-coded using TypeScript, React, and Tauri. The goal? A tool that’s:
Clean & simple – no clutter, just your habits and progress


Privacy-first – 100% local storage, no login required


Powerful analytics – streaks, trends, completion rates


Exportable – share your monthly consistency chart as an image


Desktop-ready – works natively via Tauri, or in your browser



You can either download the ready-to-use app from Itch.io for a smooth experience, or check out the code on GitHub if you want to tinker or contribute.  
It would mean a lot if you could take a few minutes to test it out, share feedback, or suggest new features. I’m especially curious about:
How intuitive it feels

Any additional features you’d like to see

Suggestions for improvement



Thanks a ton for reading! 💛  
If you try it, feel free to comment below—I’d love to hear how you focus and grow.
articles.title: I Made a Habit Tracker Because the Free Ones Were… Not Free 😅
